latest_audits.result: The worker's v1 86/88=97.7% execution-bound figure is superseded by current arXiv v2's corrected 85/88=96.6% and 2/111=1.8% reading-only. More importantly, v2 reports blinded recoding agreement of 66/88 with kappa=0.16 and a 71.6% execution-bound share under that recoding, so the phase attribution is coding-sensitive. The paper explicitly calls execution-dependent positional rather than causal. No source-matched public exact replay bundle or protocol-matched third-party rerun was located. Strongest safe transfer: execution/reproduction is high-value evidence acquisition for executable quantitative science, but a mandatory reproduce-before-promote actuator has not itself been shown causally to improve terminal review quality.
